text: おみせでは　みた　こと　ないけど　ふしぎなアメ　しってる？

structure.jp: おみせでは　みた　こと　ないけど
structure.en: I've never seen it in shops, but

structure.jp: ふしぎなアメ　しってる？

patterns.name: 〜たことがない
patterns.span: みた　こと　ない
patterns.explanation: A past verb followed by ことがない says you have never done it; in casual talk the が is dropped. みた　こと　ない = 'have never seen it'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts like 'but', often just to lead softly into a question. みた　こと　ないけど = 'I've never seen it, but'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: しる always takes ている to mean 'know'; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual talk. しってる = 'do you know'.
